android.changelog: Browser extension for Firefox as well as Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. The app now finds the browsers on your PC and walks you through adding the extension to each (Help > Connect browsers...).

windows.changelog: Browser extension for Firefox as well as Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. The app now finds the browsers on your PC and walks you through adding the extension to each (Help > Connect browsers...).
